card.name: Space or digit inside years and numbers
card.fires_on: A space or a leading digit right before the rest of a year or number, such as the gap after a date's day or the 1 starting a year or page count. It is strongest in 'Last modified' and 'Record Modified' date stamps and in citations.

modes.label: Date stamps
modes.description: The space just before a year or numeric date in a modification line.

modes.label: Leading digit in citations
modes.description: The first digit of a year, edition or page count in a reference.
modes.example: Handbook of Proof Theory, <<1>>st Edition Preface.

modes.label: Digit in number lists
modes.description: A digit or gap inside a list of numbers or a count in a table or case series.

card.plain: It fires on the spot just before the rest of a year or number is written, mostly in dates and reference lists.
